name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 6 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-05-16, at wavelengths from 1.13 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
